explanation.en: The delimiter argument tells the CSV reader which character separates fields. It still handles quoting correctly. Different separators do not change the need to parse rows consistently.
explanation.nl: Het delimiter-argument vertelt de CSV-reader welk teken velden scheidt. Quoting wordt nog steeds correct verwerkt. Een andere separator verandert niet dat je rijen consistent moet ontleden.

solution.main.py:
import csv
with open("stations.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    names = [row["name"] for row in csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter=";")]
print(names)
